On the superior of Daring the Dawn, the Aggrivated damage is inferred
to be preventable (inferior text states cannot be prevented, whilst
this is not the case on the superior).

Can this damage be prevented by Damage prevention cards (eg Unflinching
Persistence)?

Can this damage be prevented by Blood Tears of Kephran?

Can this damage be prevented any other way?
